{{Top|leg}}
The '''Selpathian Hills''' was a location on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doniphon]]. During the [[Kwymar Suppressions]], local rebels fighting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dug into the Selpathian Hills, leading Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] to lead a platoon to root them out.
